title: More Barrels To The Med
summary:
Kirkuk - Ceyhan pipeline expected to reopen after two years
On Saturday, September 27 at 7:07 AM local time, flows resumed through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan crude oil pipeline. The pipeline had been shut since February 6, 2023. Initial flows through the pipeline will be around 180,000 barrels per day (b/d), ramping up to 230,000 b/d.
